tools.name: stelorder_get_company
tools.description: Get the STEL Order company of this APIKEY: legal name, tax number, plan, subscription status, currency and time zone. Good first call. API: GET /app/company. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) with their reference, legal name, tax number, contact details and rate. Filter by name, email, tax number or last change time. API: GET /app/clients. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with its addresses, rate and payment settings. API: GET /app/clients/{ID}. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with their name, email, phone and position. Filter by client (account_id). Use IS_NULL_VALUE as account_id for contacts with no client. API: GET /app/contacts. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with their reference, name, description, barcode and inactive or composite flags. Filter by name, reference, category or change time. API: GET /app/products. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_get_product
tools.description: Get one product or service by id, with its prices, tax and stock settings. API: GET /app/products/{ID}. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_sales_estimates
tools.description: List sales estimates (quotes) with their reference, title, date, client and document state. Filter by date range, client or state. API: GET /app/salesEstimates. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with their reference, title, date, client and document state. Filter by date range, client, state or parent document. API: GET /app/salesOrders. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_ordinary_invoices
tools.description: List ordinary invoices with their reference, title, date, client and document state. Filter by date range, client, state or change time. API: GET /app/ordinaryInvoices. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_get_ordinary_invoice
tools.description: Get one ordinary invoice by id, with its lines, client, totals and tax. API: GET /app/ordinaryInvoices/{ID}. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_invoice_receipts
tools.description: List ordinary invoice receipts: the payment items of invoices, with amount, payment term date, paid and settled flags. Use paid=false and an end_payment_term_date to find unpaid items that are due. API: GET /app/ordinaryInvoiceReceipts. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000

tools.name: stelorder_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (stock locations) with their name, description and visibility. API: GET /app/warehouses. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_stock_movements
tools.description: List stock movements (stock in, out and transfers) with date, item, warehouses, employee and real stock before and after. Filter by item, warehouse, type or change time. API: GET /app/stockMovements. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per d

tools.name: stelorder_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create one client in STEL Order. Only legal_name is required. Creates a new record in the customer's account. API: POST /app/clients. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one existing client. Fields you leave out keep their values. Setting a field changes the live client record. API: PUT /app/clients/{ID}. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create one contact (a person) in STEL Order, optionally linked to a client with account_id. API: POST /app/contacts. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "stelorder_get_company" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stelorder_list_clients, stelorder_list_contacts · Private data: stelorder_get_company, stelorder_list_clients, stelorder_list_contacts, stelorder_list_sales_estimates, stelorder_list_sales_orders, stelorder_list_ordinary_invoices, stelorder_create_client, stelorder_update_client, stelorder_create_contact · Public sink: stelorder_list_clients, stelorder_list_contacts, stelorder_create_client, stelorder_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stelorder_list_clients, stelorder_list_contacts · Private data: stelorder_get_company, stelorder_list_clients, stelorder_list_contacts, stelorder_list_sales_estimates, stelorder_list_sales_orders, stelorder_list_ordinary_invoices, stelorder_create_client, stelorder_update_client, stelorder_create_contact · Public sink: stelorder_list_clients, stelorder_list_contacts, stelorder_create_client, stelorder_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
